# SQLancer oracle scope for DelosDB MVCC

Marker: `DELOSDB_SQLANCER_PROFILE_SKELETON`.

The first DelosDB SQLancer lane should focus on provider correctness, not broad
SQL feature discovery. Generated statements should remain inside the SQL surface
already covered by deterministic DelosDB tests until failures can be minimized
and promoted into normal proof gates.

## Candidate oracles

* NoREC-style checks for predicate/result consistency on a single `delos_mvcc`
  table.
* TLP-style checks for predicate partitioning over supported expressions.
* PQS-style checks only for rows generated by the profile itself.
* heap/MVCC differential checks where Derby heap and `delos_mvcc` semantics are
  expected to match.

## Explicit exclusions

The profile should reject generated operations that are unsupported by the
current DelosDB SQL/MVCC surface, especially Java object columns, external
routines, triggers, generated columns, recursive queries, window functions,
LOB/overflow cases not covered by the target lane, and catalog-changing DDL that
cannot be minimized reliably yet.

## Handoff to the next slice

Interesting generated SQLancer cases should be reduced and moved into the
heap/MVCC differential SQL harness. The external generator remains advisory;
only minimized deterministic tests become normal DelosDB gates.
